articles.title: Brazil votes as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro lead the polls
articles.summary: Brazil began voting on 4 October 2026. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro lead the polls. A second vote looks likely, but the result is uncertain.

articles.title: Protesters Question Trump’s Plan for a Huge Arch
articles.summary: Veterans and lawmakers protested Trump’s planned 250-foot arch. They questioned its size, cost and location. A lawsuit continues, and federal approval is still pending.

articles.title: Trump heads to Ohio to support Husted in close Senate race
articles.summary: Trump’s October 3 visit aimed to help Jon Husted in Ohio’s close Senate race against Sherrod Brown. Living costs and data centers are big issues.
